gloss: halfway; in the middle (of doing something); on the way

definitions.gloss: halfway; in the middle of doing something; partway through
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something happens or is interrupted at an intermediate point during an activity or process, before it is completed.
Indicates that something happens during a journey or while going somewhere, before reaching the destination.

examples.japanese: {途中|とちゅう}で⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧。
⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{途中|とちゅう}で⟦{寝|ね}て→寝る：00470_neru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I fell asleep in the middle of the movie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{途中|とちゅう}で⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I stopped my homework halfway through and went to have dinner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{途中|とちゅう}で⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}った→寄る：02440_yoru⟧。
examples.english: On the way home, I stopped by a convenience store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧{途中|とちゅう}で⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met a friend on the way to the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧{途中|とちゅう}で⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}めた→降り始める：22638_furihajimeru⟧。
examples.english: It started raining on my way to school.

notes:
A very common adverbial expression combining ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧ (middle, midway) + で (locative/instrumental particle). Applies both to actions (partway through) and to journeys (on the way).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {途中|とちゅう}で⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧: to quit partway through
- {途中|とちゅう}で⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: to stop in the middle (of something)
- {途中|とちゅう}で⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to leave partway through
- {途中|とちゅう}で⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to change one's mind midway
- ⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{途中|とちゅう}で: on the way home
- ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧{途中|とちゅう}で: on the way (going somewhere)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: similar meaning, but で is more common when describing an action or event that occurs midway
- ⟦{最中|さいちゅう}→最中：02821_saichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the middle of — emphasizes the peak of an activity; slightly more formal
- 〜⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: while doing — describes two simultaneous actions, not interruption

USAGE:
The noun ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧ by itself means "on the way" or "midway." Adding で turns it into an adverbial phrase marking when something else happens.
